title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct conditions for alpha and proton decay, including E_d > 0 for alpha decay and -ε < 0 for proton decay.

title: Disintegration Energy Explanation
description: Important Criteria: Explain the concept of disintegration energy and how it relates to the stability of heavy nuclei.

title: Binding Energy Consideration
description: Important Criteria: Discuss the role of binding energy in determining the feasibility of proton decay in heavy nuclei.

title: Coulomb Barrier Insight
description: Optional Criteria: Mention the significance of the Coulomb barrier in the context of alpha and proton decay.

title: Stability Curve Reference
description: Optional Criteria: Reference the stability curve and its relevance to the conditions for alpha and proton decay.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid errors related to the misinterpretation of binding energies or the conditions for decay.
